utterances.text: I don't know. I handed over all the documentation that I had received, that is, the documentation that was in the archives of the municipal assembly, but I don't know whether this one was amongst those. I cannot remember.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you remember seeing that document before?

utterances.speaker: MIRKO LUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Is it a decision you're familiar with, the isolation of Croats?

utterances.speaker: MIRKO LUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. I only see this decision here, but I've seen it with the counsel.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Which counsel was that?

utterances.speaker: MIRKO LUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm referring to Mr. Pantelic.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: On the 30th of June, 1993 you were awarded a Vidovdan award, weren't you, that's a St. Vitus Day award.

utterances.speaker: MIRKO LUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the 30th of June. It's possible, yes, because I received similar awards in 1997, 1998, 1999. So it's quite possible.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And on the 30th of June, 1993 you received an award with Blagoje Simic, Milan Simic, Stevan Todorovic. You received a decoration for your "selfless contribution to the struggle for freedom and the defence of the Republika Srpska."

utterances.speaker: MIRKO LUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was not a decoration. It was a kind of commendation which was given to me by the assembly, by the municipal assembly. The assembly could issue -- could honour someone by giving him or her commendations, honorary plaques, and so on.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I'm reading from the Official Gazette of Bosanski Samac, which is in evidence here, item 35.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: Perhaps the witness could be shown Exhibit P126. 126.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Turn to Article 35, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: I have translations here for the -- which I've handed out which I can possibly tender.

utterances.speaker: MIRKO LUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Excuse me. Which decision?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: 35. Paragraph 35.

utterances.speaker: MIRKO LUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of which decision?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: It's Article 35 of the --

utterances.speaker: MIRKO LUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of which decision, please, on municipal awards.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: Could I just have a look at that for a moment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. The witness is seeking clarification.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: Could I just have a look at the document.

utterances.speaker: MR. PANTELIC
utterances.text: Maybe we could be of assistance. It's page 4 -- it's page 4 of this Official Gazette, and the number for this decision is 35, on the top left-hand corner.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Pantelic.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you see it now, Mr. Lukic?

utterances.speaker: MIRKO LUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Article 5, where you -- Mr. Simic -- the two Mr. Simics and Stevan Todorovic were all jointly awarded decorations for your selfless contributions for the struggle for freedom and defence of the --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Could the counsel please slow down.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Mr. Re, the -- whenever you are reading or you are speaking please do slow down because of the interpreters.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: I will.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: "For their selfless contribution for the struggle of freedom and the defence of Republika Srpska." I just want to ask you: What was Mr. Blagoje -- Dr. Blagoje Simic's selfless contribution for the struggle for freedom and the defence of Republika Srpska?

utterances.speaker: MIRKO LUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a decision adopted by the assembly. It was the assembly that adopted this decision. I could not comment on the position taken by the commission for decorations.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What was your own selfless contribution to the struggle for freedom and the defence of the Republika Srpska?

utterances.speaker: MIRKO LUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I received a decoration for my work, for my work in the executive council in the field of economy and social work.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Well, that's not what it says. It says for your selfless contribution to the struggle for freedom and the defence of Republika Srpska. It doesn't say for humanitarian work, does it?

utterances.speaker: MIRKO LUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: In the decision on decorations, it is specified. This is just a general provision. I know that the commendation states that I was decorated for my work in the field of economy and social work.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What about in Article 2 with Crni?

utterances.speaker: MIRKO LUKIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. There are other names here as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: Your Honour, I note the time. I have almost finished.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: So?

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: I'm just noting the time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: This is the last question?

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: For today?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Because you are saying you've almost finished, so I'm asking what that means.

utterances.speaker: MR. RE
utterances.text: It may take me another ten minutes or so -- or five to ten minutes. That's all I'm saying.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Since there's going to be re-examination anyway, we'll adjourn until tomorrow. Tomorrow we are starting our session at 0930 hours and we'll sit in the afternoon as well. So the court will rise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
